name: AMH (American Homes 4 Rent)
notes: Researched from public amh.com pages (Residents, Fees) and the RentCafe payment-confirmation help article (AMH's portal is amh.securecafe.com). Make online payment / Make Payment go to the RentCafe resident login. Fees page: credit card surcharge 2.2% (2.0% in OK, none in CO) - modelled as 2.2%; late fee $100 in most states (CO $50; NV/NM/NC and Dayton OH 5%; TN 10% of past-due) - modelled $100; NSF fees by state ($20-$50). Phone 833-736-8264 (Residents page) and 855-774-4663 (Fees page). Autopay/notice rules are not on public AMH pages (family RentCafe-style Auto-pay kept, inferred). The RentCafe sign-in page is behind a bot wall, so sign-in labels are not set. REVIEW 2026-10-09 (independent reviewer): verified Residents and Fees pages (late fees by state, NSF examples AZ $25 / FL $40 / GA and TX $30, phones). Removed labels.contact ('Maintenance Requests' is the logged-in maintenance link, not the contact/message page). Payment-confirmation article cites rentcafe.com (the portal vendor AMH uses at amh.securecafe.com), a vendor page rather than an AMH page. Nav labels adjusted to match (contact page no longer called maintenance requests).

sources.title: How do I know if my payment is confirmed? (RentCafe)

pay_online.note: Make Payment opens the AMH resident portal; credit cards carry a 2.2% surcharge.

autopay.note: AMH's portal is RentCafe, which offers Auto-pay Setup; AMH does not publish its own autopay rules.

help.title: Rent payment fees
paragraphs: Paying by credit card adds a surcharge of 2.2% of the payment (2.0% in Oklahoma; no surcharge in Colorado).

Late rent fees depend on the state: most states charge a flat $100; Colorado charges $50; Nevada, New Mexico, North Carolina and the City of Dayton, Ohio charge 5% of monthly rent; Tennessee charges 10% of the past-due rent for the current month only.

Returned (NSF) payments also carry a state-specific fee between $20 and $50, for example $40 in Florida, $30 in Georgia and Texas, and $25 in Arizona. Your lease lists every fee. Questions: 855-774-4663.

help.title: Confirming your payment
paragraphs: Right after you pay, a confirmation screen shows the payment is processing and lets you download a receipt. You can also open Monthly Charges in the resident portal: a processed payment shows in your balance.
If you saw no confirmation and your balance did not change, the payment probably did not go through. A failed payment is not retried; you get an email and need to submit a new one-time payment.

help.title: Paying rent
paragraphs: Use Make online payment on the Residents page (or Make Payment in the account menu) to open the AMH resident portal and pay. Credit card payments carry a 2.2% surcharge. For help call 833-736-8264.

help.title: Contact AMH
paragraphs: Residents can call 833-736-8264, submit a maintenance request online from the Residents page, or find local offices under Our offices. For fee questions call 855-774-4663.
